org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.nativewindow.NativeWindow3D
All Implemented Interfaces:
WindowResizeListener, NativeWindowMonitor, LgEventSource
public class NativeWindow3D extends Frame3D implements WindowResizeListener, NativeWindowMonitor
NativeWindow3D provides the anchor for rendering Native window system windows.
